summary: This clinical trial is testing a mix of common medications to treat type 2 diabetes in people who also have controlled cancers. The study is evaluating how well these treatments work by measuring blood sugar and insulin levels over time. It plans to include 600 adult participants between the ages of 24 and 64. The study is currently Active, not recruiting with the NCT07033585 identifier.
